title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Spearmint Cooler Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Spearmint Cooler Nic Salt delivers a sweet, herbal Mint flavour with a clean, cooling exhale. Its a crisp and simple profile that's ideal for vapers who enjoy a brisk, menthol-style vape with a sweeter edge. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt is made for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Choose 10mg or 20mg strength for smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine relief. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
